items.name: Chicken Mince (Keema), Raw
items.src: IFCT 2017 chicken breast (168) / thigh (200) skinless; USDA ground chicken raw 143 kcal as lower bound
items.note: raw weight; butcher keema is a breast+thigh mix, fat 6-12 g depending on trimming

items.name: Mutton Mince (Keema), Raw
items.src: equal to IFCT 2017 goat shoulder (188 kcal, P20.3, F11.9); butcher keema is shoulder/leg trimmings
items.note: raw weight; very fatty keema can reach 230+ kcal, lean leg keema ~150

items.name: Chicken Breast, Boiled / Grilled (Skinless, Boneless)
items.src: USDA roasted chicken breast without skin (165 kcal, P31, F3.6); IFCT raw breast reads fatter, so a slightly higher fat is used
items.note: cooked weight, lightly salted, no oil; add ~40 kcal per tsp of oil used for pan-grilling

items.name: Dried Fish (Sukha Machhli / Karuvadu), Salted
items.src: NIN Nutritive Value of Indian Foods dried fish range (protein 55-65 g) + USDA dried salted cod 290 kcal
items.note: sun-dried and heavily salted; sodium varies 1500-8000 mg per 100 g, so BP patients should treat it as very high salt; usually eaten 15-30 g as a side

items.name: Bombay Duck, Dried (Sukha Bombil)
items.src: estimated from dried-fish composition (NIN dried fish, USDA dried cod) scaled to IFCT Bombay duck protein
items.note: sun-dried, heavily salted; sodium varies 2000-6000 mg per 100 g

items.name: Tuna, Canned in Water (Drained)
items.src: USDA canned light tuna in water, drained (116 kcal, P25.5, F0.8); Indian cans slightly saltier
items.note: drained weight; tuna in oil or mayo is 190-250 kcal; brined cans can reach 400-500 mg sodium

items.name: Processed Cheese (Slice / Cube)
items.src: packaged-label range for Indian processed cheese (Amul/Britannia ~290-330 kcal, P18-22, F22-26, sodium 1000-1300)
items.note: high in sodium: a single slice carries ~240 mg

items.name: Cheddar Cheese
items.src: USDA cheddar cheese (403 kcal)
items.note: natural cheddar; Indian packaged cheddar blocks are usually processed, closer to 330-370 kcal

items.name: Mozzarella Cheese
items.src: USDA mozzarella whole milk (300 kcal) and packaged Indian pizza mozzarella labels (~280-300)
items.note: whole-milk mozzarella; part-skim low-moisture is ~250-280 kcal

items.name: Paneer, Low Fat (Toned / Skimmed Milk)
items.src: packaged low-fat paneer labels (Amul/Mother Dairy lite ranges 170-230 kcal) vs IFCT full-fat paneer 258
items.note: brands vary a lot, check the pack; full-fat paneer is IFCT 258 kcal

items.name: Fresh Cream (25% fat)
items.src: packaged fresh cream label (25% fat, ~245-260 kcal); heavy whipping cream is ~340
items.note: restaurant 'cream' in gravies is usually this; whipping cream (35% fat) ~330 kcal

items.name: Malai (Milk Cream)
items.src: home malai from boiled full-fat milk; cream fat ~20-30% (buffalo milk malai richer)
items.note: varies with milk fat and how long it was boiled; cow-milk malai ~20-25% fat (~230 kcal), buffalo ~30% (~300)

items.name: Chhena (Fresh, Unpressed Cottage Cheese)
items.src: Indian dairy handbook values for cow-milk chhena (moisture ~55-60 %); softer and wetter than pressed paneer (IFCT 258)
items.note: unsweetened, drained but not pressed; fat depends on milk used

items.name: Condensed Milk, Sweetened
items.src: USDA sweetened condensed milk (321 kcal) and Nestle Milkmaid label (~320-330)
items.note: about 55 % sugar, avoid for diabetes

items.name: Milk Powder, Whole (Full Cream)
items.src: USDA whole milk powder (496 kcal) and Indian full-cream powder labels (~490-510)
items.note: dry powder, not reconstituted; about 4 tbsp powder makes 1 glass

items.name: Milk Powder, Skimmed (Non-fat)
items.src: USDA nonfat dry milk (362 kcal)
items.note: dry powder, not reconstituted

items.name: Whey, Liquid (Paneer Ka Pani)
items.src: USDA sweet whey, liquid (27 kcal)
items.note: the water left after making paneer from milk; lactose is the main carb

items.name: Whey Protein Powder (Concentrate)
items.src: typical whey concentrate pack label (370-400 kcal, P 72-80 per 100 g)
items.note: dry powder; isolates are ~360-380 kcal with P 85-90; flavoured/mass-gainer powders differ widely

items.name: Milk, Skimmed (Fat-free)
items.src: USDA skim milk (34 kcal) and FSSAI skimmed milk standard (fat <=0.5 %)
items.note: per 100 ml

items.name: Milk, Toned (3% fat, Packaged)
items.src: FSSAI toned milk standard (3.0 % fat, 8.5 % SNF) matches pouch labels ~58 kcal/100 ml
items.note: per 100 ml; this is the everyday city pouch milk

items.name: Milk, Double Toned (1.5% fat, Packaged)
items.src: FSSAI double-toned milk standard (1.5 % fat, 9 % SNF), pouch labels ~45-47 kcal/100 ml
items.note: per 100 ml

items.name: Milk, Full Cream (6% fat, Packaged)
items.src: FSSAI full-cream milk standard (6 % fat, 9 % SNF), pouch labels ~85-90 kcal/100 ml
items.note: per 100 ml; standardised 4.5 % milk is ~72 kcal

items.name: Milk, A2 (Desi Cow)
items.src: desi cow milk composition (fat 3.5-4.5 %), consistent with IFCT cow milk 73 and A2 pack labels ~65-70
items.note: per 100 ml; calories are the same as ordinary cow milk, only the beta-casein type differs

items.name: Milk, Goat
items.src: NIN Nutritive Value of Indian Foods goat milk (72 kcal); USDA 69
items.note: per 100 ml

items.name: Soy Milk, Unsweetened
items.src: USDA soy milk unsweetened (33 kcal) and Indian packaged soy milk labels
items.note: per 100 ml; sweetened or flavoured packs are 45-60 kcal

items.name: Almond Milk, Unsweetened
items.src: USDA almond milk unsweetened (15 kcal) and Indian packaged unsweetened almond drink labels (13-24)
items.note: per 100 ml; commercial almond milk is mostly water with ~2 % almonds; sweetened is 40-60 kcal

items.name: Oat Milk, Unsweetened
items.src: oat drink pack labels (Oatly/Indian brands 40-50 kcal/100 ml)
items.note: per 100 ml; carbohydrate is mostly malt sugar made during processing, so it raises blood sugar faster than soy or almond milk

items.name: Curd (Dahi), Whole Milk
items.src: USDA plain whole-milk yogurt (61 kcal); NIN/IFCT cow-milk dahi
items.note: home-set dahi from cow/full-fat milk, no sugar; thick buffalo-milk dahi is ~95

items.name: Curd (Dahi), Buffalo Milk (Thick)
items.src: derived from IFCT buffalo milk (107 kcal, F6.6) with a normal set-curd lactose loss
items.note: dahi set from undiluted buffalo milk, common in North India; ~50 % more calories than cow-milk dahi

items.name: Curd (Dahi), Toned Milk (Packaged)
items.src: packaged dahi label range (toned milk, 55-60 kcal/100 g)
items.note: plain, unsweetened

items.name: Curd (Dahi), Low Fat
items.src: packaged low-fat dahi labels (40-50 kcal/100 g)
items.note: plain; fat-free versions ~38

items.name: Hung Curd (Chakka / Strained Dahi)
items.src: whole-milk dahi with roughly 40-50 % of the whey drained; USDA plain Greek whole-milk yogurt 97
items.note: thickness varies; hung overnight in muslin, no sugar

items.name: Greek Yogurt, Plain
items.src: USDA plain Greek yogurt (whole 97, nonfat 59) and Indian pack labels (~85-100)
items.note: unsweetened, regular-fat; fat-free versions are ~55-60 kcal, flavoured ones 100-130

items.name: Buttermilk (Chaas / Chhach), Plain
items.src: NIN buttermilk (15 kcal) and 1 part dahi to 3 parts water; INDB salted lassi 19
items.note: thin home chaas with a pinch of salt and jeera, about 0.3 % salt; thick or packaged spiced chaas is 25-40 kcal/100 ml
